task.caption_snippet: Synthetic single-panel UV_Vis benchmark chart, variant 02. Scenario: time evolving spectra.
task.special_notes: Benchmark task seeded as a single-panel UV-Vis spectrum benchmark panel; route it through anchoring and curve extraction even if it is not LSV. Inspect the image only and do not use external source files.

anchoring_response.interpretation_notes: Single-panel UV-Vis spectrum figure with four time-series curves and an in-panel legend at upper right. No explicit subpanel letter is visible, so the full figure was treated as the target panel. Axes are fully visible and bounded by a rectangular frame; no shared axes or inset are present.

anchor_points.note: Leftmost x tick aligned with the left plot border.
Rightmost x tick aligned with the right plot border.

x.visible_pattern: X-axis ticks are evenly spaced from 300 to 800 in 100 nm increments across the full plot width.
x.justification: Axis-fit validation selected a linear model with normalized RMSE about 0.00024, far better than log10, matching the visually uniform tick spacing.

y.visible_pattern: Y-axis ticks are evenly spaced from 0.0 to 1.2 in 0.2 a.u. increments from bottom to top.
y.justification: Axis-fit validation selected a linear model with normalized RMSE about 0.00037; log10 is incompatible with the visible zero tick.

unresolved_ambiguities: No explicit subpanel letter is visible in the image; the single full-figure panel was anchored as the target panel.

response.overlap_recovery_reason: Short peak-region occlusions remain near the black 0 min trace, and the other traces share a nearly coincident low-baseline tail.

curves.overlap_notes: Short occlusion near the shared peak where later curves overdraw the black trace.
curves.suspected_gap_notes: Short hidden section around x~397-410 near the peak.

curves.overlap_notes: Right-side baseline region becomes geometrically ambiguous with the other decayed traces; truncated before the shared tail.
curves.suspected_gap_notes: No points kept after x~740 because the blue dashed tail rides the shared baseline too closely for clean normalization.

curves.overlap_notes: The right-side baseline overlaps the other traces in geometry even though the red dash-dot remains color-separable.
The right-side baseline overlaps the other traces in geometry even though the green dotted trace remains color-separable.

response.interpretation_notes: Four UV-Vis spectra are present. The black 0 min trace is strongest for normalization; the other traces remain color-separable but collapse onto a shared low baseline toward the right side.
unresolved_ambiguities: The black 0 min curve is briefly hidden near the shared peak where later traces pass over it.
The non-black traces converge onto a shared baseline on the far right, so only the black curve is retained as normalization-usable.

advisories.note: For marker-bearing curves, strong near-border fractions can indicate marker-rim or frame-lock tracing even when color overlap is high. Hollow-marker centerline traces use relaxed stroke-overlap thresholds only when marker-center alignment is also good.

panel_acceptance.pass: all curves pass and no pairwise review flags
panel_acceptance.warn: no curve fails, but at least one curve warns or at least one pair is overlap-flagged
panel_acceptance.fail: at least one curve fails stroke agreement or extent coverage
